title: The Memory Keeper’s Secret Letter
summary: A fictional exploration story: you find a letter without a sender. Five fragments lead to the University of Economics, the University of Đà Nẵng: an address, a starting year and intervals waiting to be joined.
area: Trường Đại học Kinh tế – Đại học Đà Nẵng
safetyNote: Observe from public areas without blocking the entrance. Do not enter restricted university areas; follow signs and local instructions.

checkpoints.title: The number that opens the gate
checkpoints.story: The first page has an empty address field. The memory keeper asks you to confirm the number on Ngũ Hành Sơn Street before opening the next page. This fictional clue refers to a real address; no letter is hidden at the university gate.
checkpoints.instruction: From a public area, check the address and enter its building number. Do not enter restricted areas.
checkpoints.placeLabel: Public area near the university entrance

challenge.prompt: What is the university’s building number on Ngũ Hành Sơn Street?

checkpoints.hint: Find the building number in the address, not a year mentioned in the story.
checkpoints.feedback: The letter has its address. The next fragment establishes the timeline’s starting point.

checkpoints.title: Half a century
checkpoints.story: The inside page says “fifty years”, but ink covers its starting point. The keeper recalls the starting year mentioned by the university: 1975. Choose that fragment to anchor the story’s timeline, rather than guessing the age of a building.
checkpoints.instruction: Read the story and choose the stated starting year.
checkpoints.placeLabel: Public area near the university entrance

challenge.prompt: Which starting year matches the university’s fifty-year journey?

options.label: Year 1965
Year 1975
Year 1995

checkpoints.hint: Read the starting year stated in the letter; the other years are distractors.
checkpoints.feedback: The starting point is restored. The loose year fragments can now share a timeline.

checkpoints.title: Fragments of time
checkpoints.story: Four paper fragments fall out of the envelope in the wrong order. The keeper asks for no new historical research: this is a logic puzzle using years as clues. Arrange them from earliest to latest without assuming every year marks a ceremony.
checkpoints.instruction: Choose fragments in order; use the move controls to correct positions.
checkpoints.placeLabel: Public area near the university entrance

challenge.prompt: Arrange the four year fragments from earliest to latest.

checkpoints.hint: Compare the four year values: the smallest begins and the largest ends the sequence.
checkpoints.feedback: The pages run in chronological order. The keeper still needs the distances between them.

checkpoints.title: Joining the ends of memory
checkpoints.story: The ordered fragments reveal empty intervals on their reverse sides. Use 1975 as the starting point and calculate the distance to each year. These numbers are keys to the letter’s matching puzzle, not claims about activities at the university.
checkpoints.instruction: Match each year to the interval from 1975. Use each option once.
checkpoints.placeLabel: Public area near the university entrance

challenge.prompt: Which interval belongs to each year?

options.label: 40 years
Starting point (0 years)
50 years
25 years

checkpoints.hint: Subtract 1975 from each year. Every interval has one matching year.
checkpoints.feedback: The intervals fit. One final fragment asks you to check the whole letter before sealing it.

checkpoints.title: The half-century cipher
checkpoints.story: The keeper gives you a final copy mixing accurate lines with copying mistakes. The address, 1975 and the intervals were established earlier. Keep only statements agreeing fully with those pages to return a complete letter: not every line is reliable.
checkpoints.instruction: Select all correct statements. Extra or missing choices leave the copy incorrect.
checkpoints.placeLabel: Public area near the university entrance

challenge.prompt: Select every accurate memory fragment to seal the letter.

options.label: The starting address has building number 71.
The starting address has building number 1975.
The story’s starting year is 1975.
The year 2000 is 25 years after the starting point.
The year 2015 is 50 years after the starting point.
The year 2015 is 40 years after the starting point.
The year 2025 is 50 years after the starting point.
The year 2025 is 60 years after the starting point.

checkpoints.hint: Check each line against the address and intervals from 1975. Extra selections also make the copy wrong.
checkpoints.feedback: The seal closes. The letter now has a clear address, timeline and meaning to return to its keeper.

ending: The letter has all five fragments again. Its keeper had not lost the past; they needed a reader who could distinguish an address, a milestone and an interval. Return the completed fictional letter, then take a fresh journal page to Dragon Bridge to follow a line of light by the river.
